premises.text: There is a growing number of connected devices that can be integrated into a smart clock
premises.evidence_span: Recent market research says six billion connected things will be in use till the end of this year.

premises.text: People use multiple apps to manage their digital lives
premises.evidence_span: I personally use more than 50 different apps to manage my digital life.

premises.text: A smart wall clock can provide glanceable information from various sources
premises.evidence_span: Glenn's clock is a well-designed wall clock with embedded glanceable display, building speaker and open cloud platform.

premises.text: The clock can integrate with various apps and services through an open API
premises.evidence_span: To actually meet Glenn's clock with your favorite apps you just need to go down to the app through the list and tap a connect button.

premises.text: The clock can display different data based on location and situation
premises.evidence_span: It will display different data but always relevant for particular place and the situation.

premises.text: The clock can automatically set the current time when paired with a phone
premises.evidence_span: you just need to pair your phone with the clock and it will set up current time automatically.

premises.text: The product is designed for both home and office use
premises.evidence_span: Well next, Glenn's is perfect for an office.

premises.text: The product will be launched through a crowdfunding campaign
premises.evidence_span: To introduce Glenn's clock to market we will launch Indiegogo campaign on February this year.

premises.text: The product will have a low estimated price point
premises.evidence_span: the estimated price will be just $1.49 for a single device.

value.text: Users can manage their digital lives more efficiently with a smart wall clock
value.evidence_span: There should be a nicer way to communicate with technology rather than checking your phone every single minute.

notes: Pre-orders and raffle details excluded as traction.
